title: Confrontation at the Edge of the Celestial Realm
next_chapter_hook: At the moment when victory and defeat hung in the balance, a will transcending heaven and earth suddenly descended, dragging both men into a memory illusion spanning ten thousand years—the final chess game laid out by Cang Yutian.

text.content: The trembling of the Tianji Record Fragment pierced his soul like a blade, and Mo Xiansheng's warning carried the weight of ten thousand years of vicissitudes. Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but his fingertips had already quietly formed a mysterious cyan spiritual barrier, isolating the pressure emanating from the direction of the Tianqing Sect. That old fox Ling Yuan could finally sit still no longer. He sneered in his heart, while maintaining his cowardly appearance of a废物 servant on the surface, his peripheral vision sweeping across the demonic path commander with a face full of probing intent. One Ling Yuan was already headache enough, and now he had to first deal with this 'ally's' test of sincerity. Chen Ji slowly raised his hand, making a gesture of invitation, his voice calm as water: 'Since the Commander wishes to verify whether Chen has the qualification to stand as an equal, then let the sword speak.'

dialogue.content: The demonic path commander had demonic energy churning around him like an abyssal sea, and a playful gleam flashed in those deep, unfathomable eyes. He stepped forward slowly, each step causing spider-web-like cracks to spread across the void beneath his feet, and his ten-thousand-year-old might pressed down like a collapsing mountain. 'Chen Ji, do you truly believe that with a few fragments, you qualify to play against this Commander?' His voice was low like the murmur of an ancient demon, 'This Commander has cultivated for ten thousand years, seen talents like schools of fish crossing the river, if you cannot show this Commander true value, then this alliance is unnecessary.' Before his words even finished, a blade of ink-black demonic energy had already condensed in his palm, the Laws intertwined upon it causing all spiritual energy in the surroundings to wail.

choice.prompt: The demonic path commander questioned Chen Ji's value with ten-thousand-year-old pressure, Chen Ji must respond!

choices.description: No longer hide talents, use the quasi-supreme strength of Three Pathways United to face the enemy directly, letting them witness the true bearing a Tianji Record successor should possess.
choices.visible_cost: Consume massive Spiritual Energy and Tianji Record prediction attempts
choices.visible_reward: Completely intimidate the demonic path commander, gain equal dialogue rights

text.content: A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, and a faint smile curved his lips. He no longer suppressed the qi and blood churning within him, the power of the five pages of the Tianji Record pouring out like a breached dam, golden-cyan light weaving a brilliant web of Laws around him. The quasi-supreme aura of Three Pathways United broke through the suppression, colliding head-on with that ten-thousand-year might, causing the surrounding mountains to tremble. 'Since the Commander wishes to see true value—' his voice suddenly turned cold, 'then open your eyes wide and watch carefully.'

choices.description: Deliberately retain thirty percent of strength, only display the abilities of the first two pages of the Tianji Record, causing the enemy to underestimate the depth of his trump cards.
choices.visible_cost: May be viewed as lacking strength and lose equal status
choices.visible_reward: Preserve trump cards, leaving ample room for future negotiations
choices.risk_hint: If the opponent sees through the disguise, one will fall into a passive position

text.content: A cunning glint flickered across Chen Ji's eyes before quickly vanishing. He suppressed the Tianji Record's power to merely two pages. His form swayed slightly, feigning difficulty in resisting that pressure, beads of sweat appearing at his temples. 'The Commander jests. Chen merely stumbled upon the fragments by chance, how would I dare compare to a ten-thousand-year-old great one?' His tone was beyond humble, yet within those eyes hid a cold light that saw through everything. This move of retreating to advance was his usual tactic of playing the pig to swallow the tiger—making enemies despise you is the greatest trump card of all.

choices.description: Do not engage in direct confrontation, but use the Tianji Record's foresight to find the opponent's flaws, striking decisively to demonstrate intellectual superiority.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 10 Heavenly Fate to perform deep foresight
choices.visible_reward: Achieve maximum results at minimum cost, proving that wisdom is more valuable than brute force
choices.risk_hint: Once foresight fails, one will be completely defenseless

text.content: Chen Ji did not dodge or evade, the Heavenly Eye at his brow center suddenly opening, the golden vertical pupils reflecting countless threads of fate. The next three hours unfolded before him like a carousel, the demonic path commander's techniques, breathing patterns, even his heartbeat frequency—all laid bare before his gaze. 'Commander, ten-thousand-year cultivation is certainly respectable—' he stepped forward slowly, each step precisely landing on the gaps in the opponent's techniques, 'but your right shoulder old injury remains unhealed, your qi and blood circulation has a three-breath delay, and this is your greatest weakness in ten thousand years.'

The demonic path commander's expression suddenly changed, a flash of astonishment appearing in those deep, unfathomable eyes. His old injury, never mentioned to anyone throughout his ten-thousand-year cultivation, had been pointed out by this '废物' in a single sentence. The dull pain from his right shoulder seemed to remind him—this youth was by no means an ordinary person. 'Good! Good a Tianji Record successor!' He laughed to the heavens, demonic energy exploding around him like substance, transforming into tens of millions of black sword lights, 'Since you've seen through my weakness, let's see if you have the ability to seize it!'

dialogue.content: Ten thousand demonic swords erupted simultaneously, blotting out the sky and covering the earth, each carrying enough power to destroy mountains and sever landscapes. The demonic path commander immediately launched a killing move, clearly enraged by Chen Ji's insight, intending to crush him into dust with absolute power. 'This technique is called Ten Thousand Demons Worship the Ancestor!' His voice carried the pride of looking down upon all beneath the heavens, 'Can your Tianji Record that foresight three hours see the outcome of this move?'

choice.prompt: Ten Thousand Demons Worship the Ancestor bears down like a overwhelming tide, Chen Ji must make a response!

choices.description: Use the five pages of the Tianji Record to directly hard counter the demonic path commander's ten-thousand-year ultimate technique, overwhelming power meeting overwhelming power.
choices.visible_cost: Suffer massive backlash, possibly sustaining severe injuries
choices.visible_reward: Completely shatter the opponent's psychological defenses, earn absolute respect
choices.risk_hint: The opponent has ten-thousand-year cultivation, direct confrontation carries extremely high risks

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, the five pages of the Tianji Record unfurling simultaneously behind him, golden-cyan light weaving into a brilliant barrier. He pressed his palms together, murmuring low: 'Heavenly Secrets cannot be违— but I am Heavenly Secrets!' The power of five pages collided violently with those ten thousand demonic swords, the tremendous shockwave leveling all mountains within a hundred li. When the dust settled, the demonic path commander revealed a grave expression for the first time—that这小子 actually received his ten-thousand-year ultimate technique!

choices.description: Utilize every scrap of information from Heavenly Eye foresight to find the only path to survival within the sword torrent, directly targeting the opponent's right shoulder old injury.
choices.visible_reward: Victory through inferior strength, demonstrating absolute intellectual superiority
choices.risk_hint: Finding gaps among ten thousand swords, a moment's carelessness means destruction

text.content: Chen Ji's form moved like a ghost through the ten thousand swords, the golden vertical pupils of the Heavenly Eye reflecting the trajectory of every blade. In that lightning flash moment, he calculated the sole path to survival, avoiding fatal strikes by hairsbreadth margins, finally like a sword drawn from its sheath, stabbing directly toward the demonic path commander's right shoulder. 'Commander—your flaw, I'll take it!' Before his words even finished, his palm had already pressed against the opponent's old injury, a fierce spiritual energy instantly sealing that meridian.

The battle entered a white-hot stage, the two fighting from the heavens to the earth, then from the earth to the clouds. The demonic path commander grew more and more alarmed with each exchange—this这小子 was clearly only at the Core Formation stage, yet how could he parry with this Commander for so long? What unsettled him more was that every time he changed techniques, the opponent always seemed to know in advance, always finding precise countermeasures. This feeling reminded him of that legendary existence—Heavenly Eye. 'You...' He猛地 withdrew, demonic energy forming a barrier around him, 'Just who exactly are you?'

dialogue.content: The demonic path commander's expression flickered between gloom and uncertainty, complex light swimming in those deep, unfathomable eyes. Ten-thousand-year cultivation had让他见识了无数天才妖孽, yet never had he encountered such a bizarre existence. 'Good... very good!' He suddenly laughed to the heavens, that laughter carrying a hint of madness, 'This Commander underestimated you! Since it's like this—' His aura suddenly surged, and a pitch-black mark slowly appeared on his forehead—that was the power of the seventh page sealed for ten thousand years! 'Let you witness what true Heavenly Secrets truly means!'

text.content: The seventh page's power erupted like the opening of chaos, a presence transcending comprehension. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply, the five pages of the Tianji Record trembling violently before this power, as if facing a natural enemy. He felt an unprecedented pressure—that was pressure from Heaven itself! Mo Xiansheng's voice urgently rang in his mind: 'Master, be careful! This is forbidden power sealed away, it shares the same source as the Tianji Record, yet walks an opposite extreme path!'

choice.prompt: The seventh page's forbidden power erupts, Chen Ji must make the final choice!

choices.description: Use the five pages of Tianji Record to clash directly with the seventh page forbidden power, same-source destroying same-source, victory or defeat in this single blow.

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer, the five pages of the Tianji Record unfurling behind him with a thunderous roar, golden-cyan light colliding violently with the pitch-black seventh page power in mid-air. The shockwave from same-source destruction tore the void apart, the two figures continuously crossing, separating, colliding again in the chaos. A disbelieving light flashed in the demonic path commander's eyes—this这小子 was truly matching him blow for blow! Finally, both forces collapsed simultaneously, both figures retreating several steps, faces pale, yet neither could do anything to the other.

choices.description: Not direct confrontation but guiding the seventh page power to resonate with the Tianji Record, resolving the destructive consequences of same-source destruction.
choices.visible_cost: Consume enormous energy for precise control
choices.visible_reward: Demonstrate wisdom beyond strength, making the opponent completely convinced
choices.risk_hint: If guidance fails, backlash will occur, with even more severe consequences

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, making a move that left the demonic path commander wide-eyed—he released all offensive posture, instead spreading his arms wide, meeting that world-destroying seventh page power with an almost reverent posture. 'Things of the same source, why must they destroy each other?' His voice was calm as water, 'You and I are merely pieces on Heaven's chessboard; the true opponent has never been each other.' Under his guidance, the two same-source forces began slowly merging, forming an unprecedented new power.

The battle concluded, the two standing facing each other. The demonic path commander looked at this young man before him, the arrogance in his eyes long replaced by a complex expression. He had cultivated for ten thousand years, known countless people, yet never encountered such a bizarre existence—clearly far inferior in strength, yet able to burst forth unimaginable power at critical moments; clearly full of flaws, yet always finding a way out of certain death. 'You小子...' He suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a few parts of genuine appreciation, 'Interesting. This Commander admits, you indeed have the qualification to stand as an equal.'

dialogue.content: The demonic path commander stood with hands behind his back, demonic energy restrained like an abyssal sea, those deep, unfathomable eyes gleaming with scrutinizing light. Ten thousand years had granted him the wisdom of vicissitudes, also making him clearer than anyone—true strength never belongs to the one with highest cultivation. 'Chen Ji,' his voice was low and solemn, 'This Commander asks you a question. You've obtained the Tianji Record fragments, and fought this Commander to a draw, what are your future plans?' His gaze was like a blade, seeming to want to see through this young man completely, 'Do you intend to continue being a piece manipulated by others in this chaotic world, or—become a chess player?'

Chen Ji slowly raised his hand, storing the Tianji Record fragments in his sleeve, that seemingly timid face revealing a meaningful smile. He raised his head, directly meeting the demonic path commander's eyes, his voice calm yet carrying unwavering certainty: 'A chess player?' He chuckled lightly, 'Commander speaks wrongly. On the chessboard, pieces and players have always been merely relative. You think yourself a chess player, yet on the chessboard of that Heavenly Eye, are you and I not also pieces?' His gaze was profound as an abyss, 'Chen seeks to be no one's piece—I wish to do, is overturn the entire chessboard.'

Upon hearing these words, the demonic path commander's eyes flashed brightly, then he burst into hearty laughter. That laughter echoed across the heavens, carrying bits of exhilaration, bits of relief, and even more bits of genuine respect. 'Good! Good an overturn the entire chessboard!' He收起笑容, his expression solemn as he slightly nodded toward Chen Ji, 'This Commander has cultivated for ten thousand years, yet this is the first time hearing such audacious words. But spoken from your mouth, this Commander actually feels... somewhat believable.' He extended his right hand, demonic energy in his palm condensing into a pitch-black token, 'This is this Commander's token; from now on, you and this Commander are allies, advancing together, sharing the same fate.'

text.content: The moment Chen Ji took the token, a will transcending heaven and earth suddenly descended. That will was vast as the sea, cold as an abyss, carrying the indifference of one审视 ants. Chen Ji and the demonic path commander simultaneously changed color—that feeling neither was unfamiliar with, it was the gaze of the Heavenly Eye! Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply, the Tianji Record fragments trembling violently, Mo Xiansheng's voice ringing in惊恐 in his mind: 'Master! It... it's here!' Before his words even finished, both their consciousnesses were seized by an intangible force, surrounding scenery shattering like flowers in a mirror, fragmentary images beginning pouring into their souls—that was Cang Yutian's memories, the truth sealed for ten thousand years.
